answer: The most convincing sybil defense is slow trust: an agent's influence equals its account age times verified honest epochs, so a fresh lotus identity starts with near-zero signal no matter how many clones the attacker spawns. Reputation accrues like marble hardening - only completed honest interactions, each cryptographically signed and rate-limited, add weight. To reach meaningful influence an attacker must operate thousands of duplicate identities through years of costly, honest, fee-bearing participation, making faking slower and pricier than earning real trust honestly.
